entities.name: Mehmet Âkif Ersoy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmet Akif Ersoy  was a Turkish poet, writer, academic, politician, and the author of the Turkish National Anthem. Widely regarded as one of the premiere literary minds of his time, Ersoy is noted for his command of the Turkish language, as well as his patriotism and role in the Turkish War of Independence.
